subject: wishful thinking - perform calculations with bin counts in bin2d

messages.author: 6d91a9061453aa7b
messages.subject: wishful thinking - perform calculations with bin counts in bin2d
parts:
Hello all,

I'm wondering if it's possible to use bin counts in stat_bin2d (and
even stat_bin) in a calculation whose value will ultimately be shown
in the legend. Or I suppose a more general request would be to perform
calculations on the count values in the legend. I'd like to display
the counts per bin volume, or concentration, rather than raw counts.
From my dataset, I plot x-y data, and would multiply the bin area by
the system z height to get bin volume. Is this possible with ggplot2?

Otherwise, I could emulate it by calculating the concentration myself
and perhaps using geom_polygon to plot it. Any ideas? Thanks.

Faisal
